feeds.title: Runs With Pugs
feeds.description: Runs With Pugs tells you about our running experiences and other fun updates. My name is Jenn and this is the story of my love affair with running and finding myself through fitness. From C25K to marathon, from triathlon to SUP, from broken leg to the recovery journey, I'm sharing it all. I'm a wife and mother of one, living in NE Florida, in love with travel, adventure, and food. Oh. We have pugs and a hedgehog, too.

feeds.title: SAHM, plus...
feeds.description: SAHM blogger sharing tips for parenting, marriage, travel, and finding more balance in life, because there's more to life than being a mom. Hi, I'm Ivy! I'm a wife and stay at home mom to 2 amazing (high-need) kids. I spend my days trying to figure out how to do this parenting thing and still get everything done. I'm here to share my secrets for women who are looking for ways to give time to themselves, their husbands, and their kids.

feeds.title: Geek Mamas Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about the real-life adventures of a crafty, geeky, first-time mom. Geek Mamas is dedicated to the parents who already had a stash of action figures and toys before the baby arrived, the ones who dress up as superheroes when it's not a kid's birthday or Halloween or just the ones that grew up geeky and still embrace it.
